title: Total recognized revenue
question: What is total recognized revenue across the full dataset?
expected_sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(amount), 2) AS total_revenue FROM payments WHERE status = 'paid'
expected_answer: Total recognized revenue is $14,840.00.

title: June revenue
question: How much recognized revenue did the business generate in June 2026?
expected_sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(p.amount), 2) AS june_revenue FROM payments p JOIN bookings b ON b.id = p.booking_id WHERE p.status = 'paid' AND b.scheduled_at >= '2026-06-01' AND b.scheduled_at < '2026-07-01'
expected_answer: June 2026 recognized revenue was $4,960.00.

title: Highest-revenue month
question: Which month generated the most recognized revenue, and how much was it?
expected_sql: SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', b.scheduled_at) AS month, ROUND(SUM(p.amount), 2) AS revenue FROM payments p JOIN bookings b ON b.id = p.booking_id WHERE p.status = 'paid' GROUP BY month ORDER BY revenue DESC LIMIT 1
expected_answer: 2026-06 (June 2026) generated the most recognized revenue at $4,960.00.

title: Most-booked completed service
question: Which service had the most completed bookings?
expected_sql: SELECT s.name AS service, COUNT(*) AS completed_bookings FROM bookings b JOIN services s ON s.id = b.service_id WHERE b.status = 'completed' GROUP BY s.id, s.name ORDER BY completed_bookings DESC, s.name LIMIT 1
expected_answer: Full Detail had the most completed bookings with 11.

title: Highest-revenue service
question: Which service generated the most recognized revenue?
expected_sql: SELECT s.name AS service, ROUND(SUM(p.amount), 2) AS revenue FROM payments p JOIN bookings b ON b.id = p.booking_id JOIN services s ON s.id = b.service_id WHERE p.status = 'paid' GROUP BY s.id, s.name ORDER BY revenue DESC LIMIT 1
expected_answer: Ceramic Coating generated the most recognized revenue at $7,500.00.

title: Unique paying customers
question: How many unique customers made at least one paid booking?
expected_sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT b.customer_id) AS paying_customers FROM payments p JOIN bookings b ON b.id = p.booking_id WHERE p.status = 'paid'
expected_answer: 12 unique customers made at least one paid booking.

title: Repeat customers
question: How many customers completed at least two bookings?
expected_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS repeat_customers FROM (SELECT customer_id FROM bookings WHERE status = 'completed' GROUP BY customer_id HAVING COUNT(*) >= 2)
expected_answer: 11 customers completed at least two bookings.

title: Repeat-customer rate
question: Among customers with at least one completed booking, what percentage completed two or more?
expected_sql: WITH counts AS (SELECT customer_id, COUNT(*) AS completed_count FROM bookings WHERE status = 'completed' GROUP BY customer_id) SELECT ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN completed_count >= 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 2) AS repeat_customer_rate_pct FROM counts
expected_answer: The repeat-customer rate is 91.67%.

title: No-show rate
question: What percentage of all scheduled bookings were no-shows?
expected_sql: SELECT ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'no_show' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 2) AS no_show_rate_pct FROM bookings
expected_answer: The no-show rate is 11.11% of all scheduled bookings.

title: Average paid ticket
question: What is the average amount of a paid transaction?
expected_sql: SELECT ROUND(AVG(amount), 2) AS average_paid_ticket FROM payments WHERE status = 'paid'
expected_answer: The average paid transaction is $463.75.

title: Top customer by revenue
question: Which customer generated the most recognized revenue, and how much?
expected_sql: SELECT c.name AS customer, ROUND(SUM(p.amount), 2) AS revenue FROM payments p JOIN bookings b ON b.id = p.booking_id JOIN customers c ON c.id = b.customer_id WHERE p.status = 'paid' GROUP BY c.id, c.name ORDER BY revenue DESC LIMIT 1
expected_answer: Ava Thompson generated the most recognized revenue at $3,200.00.

title: Lead conversion rate
question: What percentage of all leads converted to a booking?
expected_sql: SELECT ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'converted' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 2) AS conversion_rate_pct FROM leads
expected_answer: The overall lead conversion rate is 62.50%.

title: Open lead backlog
question: How many leads are still open?
expected_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS open_leads FROM leads WHERE status = 'open'
expected_answer: 4 leads are still open.

title: Average lead-to-booking time
question: For converted leads, what is the average number of days from lead creation to the scheduled booking date?
expected_sql: SELECT ROUND(AVG(julianday(b.scheduled_at) - julianday(l.created_at)), 2) AS average_days FROM leads l JOIN bookings b ON b.id = l.converted_booking_id WHERE l.status = 'converted'
expected_answer: Converted leads took an average of 7.07 days to reach their scheduled booking date.

title: Top technician by revenue
question: Which technician is associated with the most recognized revenue, and how much?
expected_sql: SELECT t.name AS technician, ROUND(SUM(p.amount), 2) AS revenue FROM payments p JOIN bookings b ON b.id = p.booking_id JOIN technicians t ON t.id = b.technician_id WHERE p.status = 'paid' GROUP BY t.id, t.name ORDER BY revenue DESC LIMIT 1
expected_answer: Maya Chen is associated with the most recognized revenue at $7,300.00.

title: Busiest weekday
question: Which weekday had the most completed bookings? Return the weekday name and count.
expected_sql: SELECT CASE strftime('%w', scheduled_at) WHEN '0' THEN 'Sunday' WHEN '1' THEN 'Monday' WHEN '2' THEN 'Tuesday' WHEN '3' THEN 'Wednesday' WHEN '4' THEN 'Thursday' WHEN '5' THEN 'Friday' ELSE 'Saturday' END AS weekday, COUNT(*) AS completed_bookings FROM bookings WHERE status = 'completed' GROUP BY strftime('%w', scheduled_at) ORDER BY completed_bookings DESC, weekday LIMIT 1
expected_answer: Thursday was the busiest weekday with 7 completed bookings.

title: Outstanding completed-work balance
question: What is the outstanding unpaid amount for completed bookings?
expected_sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(p.amount), 2) AS outstanding_balance FROM payments p JOIN bookings b ON b.id = p.booking_id WHERE p.status = 'unpaid' AND b.status = 'completed'
expected_answer: The outstanding balance on completed bookings is $1,250.00.

title: Best lead source by conversion
question: Which lead source has the highest conversion rate? Return the source, converted count, total count, and rate.
expected_sql: SELECT source, SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'converted' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS converted_leads, COUNT(*) AS total_leads, ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'converted' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 2) AS conversion_rate_pct FROM leads GROUP BY source ORDER BY conversion_rate_pct DESC, source LIMIT 1
expected_answer: Referral has the highest conversion rate: 4 of 5 leads, or 80.00%.

title: Month-over-month revenue growth
question: By what percentage did recognized revenue change from May 2026 to June 2026?
expected_sql: WITH monthly AS (SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', b.scheduled_at) AS month, SUM(p.amount) AS revenue FROM payments p JOIN bookings b ON b.id = p.booking_id WHERE p.status = 'paid' AND b.scheduled_at >= '2026-05-01' AND b.scheduled_at < '2026-07-01' GROUP BY month), values_pivot AS (SELECT MAX(CASE WHEN month = '2026-05' THEN revenue END) AS may_revenue, MAX(CASE WHEN month = '2026-06' THEN revenue END) AS june_revenue FROM monthly) SELECT ROUND(100.0 * (june_revenue - may_revenue) / may_revenue, 2) AS growth_pct FROM values_pivot
expected_answer: Recognized revenue increased 124.43% from May to June 2026.

title: Cancellation rate
question: What percentage of all scheduled bookings were cancelled?
expected_sql: SELECT ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'cancelled' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 2) AS cancellation_rate_pct FROM bookings
expected_answer: The cancellation rate is 8.89% of all scheduled bookings.
